header: DO NOT EDIT: regenerate with `python3 proofs/verus/gen_pin_tests.py <spec> --run`.
Each test mirrors one [pins] row of proofs/verus/shir_native_constant_pipeline_sync.txt
and drives the REAL fold (native_constant_pipeline), not a copy of it.
`pipeline_refused_*` rows are the fold's REFUSALS: it must return false and
leave the statement alone so the shell-out stays.  pin_pipefail_disagrees runs
bash both ways: the fold's answer agrees with bash without pipefail and
disagrees with it under pipefail (recorded divergence d1).

pins.note: false | true exits 0 (the last stage decides) -- bash agrees; the fold writes status true
true | false exits 1 -- the fold writes status false
three stages: only the last one's status is reported
date is not a constant builtin: it prints and may exit either way, so the shell-out must stay
conservatism: bash's `true x` still exits 0, but the fold refuses any stage with words
no stages means no status to read: the fold refuses
a stage body with two statements is refused though bash's `true;true` is still 0
a body element that is not an exec/builtin Call (here `redirect`) is refused
`exec true` is not a pipeline, and a pipeline whose argument is not an array, are both refused
d1: bash without pipefail exits 0 for `false | true`; with `set -o pipefail` it exits 1, where the fold still writes status true
